main_text.l: Et fluctus volitat per maris hospiti Nauis plura referi commoda nautiis Multo farre[?] graus merceque barbara.
Somnos illa oculis excutiens prius Surgit, purpureum quam iubar exerat Aurora, & nitidis aurea syderum Collucere polis agmina desinant.
Prouisumque suis temporibus penu Prudens distribuit: pensaque protinus Partitur famulis iusta fidelibus Iussumque vrget opus, nec tolerat moras.
Agros cauta notat queis sobolescere Frugum semper amat fertilior seges. Venalesque sibi diuite[?] comparat Auro, continuus quod peperit labor.
Foecundasque simul collibus erigit Vites pampineis: & grauidas premens Vvas vina liquat suave rubentia Syncerisque solet condere in amphoris.
Damnosam refugit desidiem impigra, Ignavamque procul pellit inertiam Nec languere sui robora brachij Probroso patitur mollior ocio.
Atque experta domum quàm faciles labor Importet reditum, & fuga inertiæ,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "farre" (first letter unclear, read as F), "graus" (may be "grauis"), "diuite" (the u/n shape is unclear, read as diuite, normalised to divite), "nautiis" as printed. The first word of the first line reads "Et"; the "N" of "Nauis" is a large initial with a gap after it, which may be a printing feature. Printed "fluctus" with ligature for ct. Long s normalised to s throughout. Verse stanzas kept as one paragraph each; the printed line breaks are shown inside each paragraph.
